ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِيْ صَدْرِيْۙ ۝۲۵ وَ يَسِّرْ لِيٓ أَمْرِيْۙ ۝۲۶ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّنْ لِّسَانِيْۙ ۝۲۷ يَفْقَهُوْا قَوْلِيْۖ ۝۲۸
tr: Rabbi ‘shraḥ lī ṣadrī wa yassir lī amrī, waḥlu ‘l `uqdatam ‘min lisānī yafqahū qawlī.
en: My Lord, open my breast for me, facilitate my task for me and clear the knot from my tongue so others can understand my speech!
blocks.review: The mark above medallion ۲۸ is a small high ص; no exact codepoint in the allowed set, transcribed as ۖ. Verifier: confirmed small ص over ۲۸ and لا (ۙ) over ۲۵–۲۷; لِيٓ madda confirmed.

ar: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِيٓ اَنْ اَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِيٓ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلٰى وَالِدَيَّ وَاَنْ اَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضٰهُ وَ أَدْخِلْنِيْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِيْ عِبَادِكَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ ۝۱۹
tr: Rabbi awzi`nī `an ashkura ni`mata ka ‘l-latī an`amta `alayya wa `alā wālidayya, wa an a`mala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa adkhilnī bi raḥmati ka fī `ibādi ka ‘ṣ-Ṣālihīna.
en: My Lord, inspire me to thank You for Your bounties with which You blessed me and my parents, so I work righteousness with which You are pleased, and join me, by Your mercy, with Your righteous servants!

ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَ ارْحَمْ وَ أَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرّٰحِمِيْنَ ۝۱۱۸
en: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, You are the Best of The Profoundly Merciful.
blocks.review: A small ع (rukūʿ sign) printed above medallion ۱۱۸ is omitted: no codepoint for it in the allowed set.
